# 字幕导出模块

## 1. 模块概述

字幕导出模块负责将编辑好的字幕数据导出为多种格式的字幕文件，支持ASS、SRT、LRC等格式。

## 2. 功能清单

| 功能 | 说明 | 优先级 |
|------|------|--------|
| ASS导出 | 导出ASS格式字幕(支持样式) | P0 |
| SRT导出 | 导出SRT格式字幕 | P0 |
| LRC导出 | 导出LRC格式歌词 | P1 |
| 字幕裁剪 | 指定时间范围导出 | P2 |
| 时间偏移 | 字幕整体时间偏移 | P2 |
| 批量导出 | 同时导出多轨道 | P2 |

## 3. 支持格式

### 3.1 ASS格式 (Advanced SubStation Alpha)

```
[Script Info]
; Script generated by DD烤肉机
Title: 视频标题
ScriptType: v4.00+
PlayResX: 1920
PlayResY: 1080

[V4+ Styles]
Format: Name, Fontname, Fontsize, ...
Style: Default,微软雅黑,90,...

[Events]
Format: Layer, Start, End, Style, Name, ...
Dialogue: 0,0:00:01.00,0:00:03.00,Default,,0,0,0,,字幕文本
```

### 3.2 SRT格式 (SubRip)

```
1
00:00:01,000 --> 00:00:03,000
字幕文本

2
00:00:04,000 --> 00:00:06,000
第二条字幕
```

### 3.3 LRC格式 (Lyric)

```
[ti:标题]
[ar:艺术家]
[al:专辑]
[by:制作]
[offset:0]
[00:01.00]第一条歌词
[00:04.00]第二条歌词
```

## 4. 数据模型

```rust
/// 导出配置
pub struct ExportConfig {
    /// 导出格式
    pub format: ExportFormat,
    /// 输出路径
    pub output_path: PathBuf,
    /// 导出的轨道
    pub tracks: Vec<usize>,
    /// 时间偏移(毫秒)
    pub time_offset: i64,
    /// 起始时间(裁剪用)
    pub start_time: Option<u64>,
    /// 结束时间(裁剪用)
    pub end_time: Option<u64>,
    /// 字幕起始时间偏移
    pub subtitle_start_offset: u64,
    /// 是否包含样式(ASS专用)
    pub include_styles: bool,
}

/// 导出格式
pub enum ExportFormat {
    Ass,
    Srt,
    Lrc,
}

/// 导出结果
pub struct ExportResult {
    /// 是否成功
    pub success: bool,
    /// 输出文件路径
    pub output_path: PathBuf,
    /// 导出的字幕数量
    pub subtitle_count: usize,
    /// 错误信息(如果有)
    pub error: Option<String>,
}
```

                           │

## 6. 格式转换函数

```rust
/// 导出ASS格式
pub fn export_ass(
    subtitles: &SubtitleStore,
    styles: &[SubtitleStyle; 5],
    config: &ExportConfig,
    script_info: &AssScriptInfo,
) -> Result<ExportResult, Error> {
    let mut ass = String::new();
    
    // Script Info
    ass.push_str("[Script Info]\n");
    ass.push_str(&format!("; Script generated by DD烤肉机\n"));
    ass.push_str(&format!("Title: {}\n", script_info.title));
    ass.push_str(&format!("OriginalScript: {}\n", script_info.original_script));
    ass.push_str(&format!("OriginalTranslation: {}\n", script_info.translation));
    ass.push_str(&format!("OriginalEditing: {}\n", script_info.editing));
    ass.push_str(&format!("OriginalTiming: {}\n", script_info.timing));
    ass.push_str(&format!("ScriptType: {}\n", script_info.script_type));
    ass.push_str(&format!("Collisions: {}\n", script_info.collisions));
    ass.push_str(&format!("PlayResX: {}\n", script_info.play_res_x));
    ass.push_str(&format!("PlayResY: {}\n", script_info.play_res_y));
    ass.push_str(&format!("Timer: {}\n", script_info.timer));
    ass.push_str(&format!("WrapStyle: {}\n", script_info.wrap_style));
    ass.push_str(&format!("ScaledBorderAndShadow: {}\n\n", 
        if script_info.scale_border_shadow { "yes" } else { "no" }));
    
    // Styles
    if config.include_styles {
        ass.push_str("[V4+ Styles]\n");
        ass.push_str("Format: Name, Fontname, Fontsize, PrimaryColour, SecondaryColour, ");
        ass.push_str("OutlineColour, BackColour, Bold, Italic, Underline, StrikeOut, ");
        ass.push_str("ScaleX, ScaleY, Spacing, Angle, BorderStyle, Outline, Shadow, ");
        ass.push_str("Alignment, MarginL, MarginR, MarginV, Encoding\n");
        
        for track_idx in &config.tracks {
            ass.push_str(&generate_ass_style(&styles[*track_idx]));
            ass.push('\n');
        }
        ass.push('\n');
    }
    
    // Events
    ass.push_str("[Events]\n");
    ass.push_str("Format: Layer, Start, End, Style, Name, MarginL, MarginR, MarginV, Effect, Text\n");
    
    for track_idx in &config.tracks {
        let track = &subtitles.tracks[*track_idx];
        for (start, (duration, text)) in track {
            let start = (*start as i64 + config.time_offset).max(0) as u64;
            
            // 时间范围过滤
            if let Some(start_time) = config.start_time {
                if start < start_time { continue; }
            }
            if let Some(end_time) = config.end_time {
                if start > end_time { continue; }
            }
            
            let line = format!(
                "Dialogue: 0,{},{},{},#{},0,0,0,,{}\n",
                ms_to_ass_time(start),
                ms_to_ass_time(start + duration),
                styles[*track_idx].name,
                track_idx + 1,
                text
            );
            ass.push_str(&line);
        }
    }
    
    // 写入文件
    std::fs::write(&config.output_path, ass)?;
    
    Ok(ExportResult {
        success: true,
        output_path: config.output_path.clone(),
        subtitle_count: count_subtitles(subtitles, &config.tracks),
        error: None,
    })
}

/// 导出SRT格式
pub fn export_srt(
    subtitles: &SubtitleStore,
    config: &ExportConfig,
) -> Result<ExportResult, Error> {
    let mut srt = String::new();
    let mut counter = 1;
    
    for track_idx in &config.tracks {
        let track = &subtitles.tracks[*track_idx];
        for (start, (duration, text)) in track {
            let start = (*start as i64 + config.time_offset).max(0) as u64;
            
            // 时间范围过滤
            if let Some(start_time) = config.start_time {
                if start < start_time { continue; }
            }
            if let Some(end_time) = config.end_time {
                if start > end_time { continue; }
            }
            
            srt.push_str(&format!("{}\n", counter));
            srt.push_str(&format!("{} --> {}\n", 
                ms_to_srt_time(start + config.subtitle_start_offset),
                ms_to_srt_time(start + duration + config.subtitle_start_offset)));
            srt.push_str(&format!("{}\n\n", text));
            counter += 1;
        }
    }
    
    std::fs::write(&config.output_path, srt)?;
    
    Ok(ExportResult {
        success: true,
        output_path: config.output_path.clone(),
        subtitle_count: counter - 1,
        error: None,
    })
}

/// 导出LRC格式
pub fn export_lrc(
    subtitles: &SubtitleStore,
    config: &ExportConfig,
) -> Result<ExportResult, Error> {
    let mut lrc = String::new();
    
    // LRC头部
    lrc.push_str("[ti:]\n[ar:]\n[al:]\n[by:]\n[offset:0]\n");
    
    for track_idx in &config.tracks {
        let track = &subtitles.tracks[*track_idx];
        for (start, (_, text)) in track {
            let start = (*start as i64 + config.time_offset).max(0) as u64;
            lrc.push_str(&format!("[{}]{}\n", ms_to_lrc_time(start), text));
        }
    }
    
    std::fs::write(&config.output_path, lrc)?;
    
    Ok(ExportResult {
        success: true,
        output_path: config.output_path.clone(),
        subtitle_count: count_subtitles(subtitles, &config.tracks),
        error: None,
    })
}
```

## 7. 消息定义

```rust
pub enum ExportMessage {
    /// 打开导出对话框
    OpenExportDialog,
    /// 选择导出格式
    SelectFormat(ExportFormat),
    /// 选择输出路径
    SelectOutputPath,
    /// 选择导出轨道
    ToggleTrack(usize),
    /// 设置时间偏移
    SetTimeOffset(i64),
    /// 设置起始时间
    SetStartTime(u64),
    /// 设置结束时间
    SetEndTime(u64),
    /// 设置字幕起始偏移
    SetSubtitleStartOffset(u64),
    /// 开始导出
    StartExport,
    /// 导出完成
    ExportComplete(ExportResult),
}
```

## 8. 与原版差异

| 功能 | DD_KaoRou2 | Rust方案 |
|------|------------|----------|
| 文件写入 | codecs.open | std::fs::write |
| 编码 | UTF-8 BOM | UTF-8 |
| 格式化 | 字符串拼接 | format!宏 |
| 错误处理 | try/except | Result类型 |
